title: Echoes of the Debate in Modern Hungary
grammar: Synthesizing polemical, concessive, and contrastive connectors in B2 essay discourse
goal: I can describe how the old populist and urbanist labels came back into Hungarian public debate after 1989.
I can use holott, jóllehet, csakhogy, ellenben and ezzel szemben to argue a point in a few sentences.
I can talk about differences between city and countryside in modern Hungary.
